cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 3.8)

project(tests)

set (CMAKE_INCLUDE_CURRENT_DIR ON)

set (SRCS
	IntervalTestCase.cpp
	LexerTestCase.cpp
	MultiAntiIntervalTestCase.cpp
	MultiIntervalTestCase.cpp
	SimpleLexer1TestCase.cpp
	CppLexerTestCase.cpp
	ErrorMngtTestCase.cpp
	ArithmeticLexerTestCase.cpp
	CharSetExprTestCase.cpp
	CommentLexerTestCase.cpp
	LexerFixture.cpp
	DescriptionReaderTestCase.cpp
	NanolexTestCase.cpp
	)

set (HEADERS
	checkLexemes.h
	LexerFixture.h
	)

# Lexers generated by testgen (see testgen/*.cpp for their definitions)
set (GEN_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
set (GEN_HEADERS
	${GEN_DIR}/CppLexer.h
	${GEN_DIR}/Simple1Lexer.h
	${GEN_DIR}/ArithmeticLexer.h
	${GEN_DIR}/CommentsLexer.h
	)

file(GLOB LEXER_SKELETONS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lexer_sk/cpp/*)

add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT ${GEN_HEADERS}
	COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:testgen> ${GEN_DIR}
	DEPENDS testgen ${LEXER_SKELETONS}
	COMMENT "Generating test lexers with testgen"
	)

# Lexers generated by nanolex from the description files in nl/ (the file base name must be the lexer name)
set (NL_LEXERS
	NlArithmetic
	NlWords
	NlActions
	NlDefault
	)
set (NL_HEADERS)
foreach (lexer ${NL_LEXERS})
	set (nl_file ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/nl/${lexer}.nl)
	add_custom_command(
		OUTPUT ${GEN_DIR}/${lexer}Lexer.h
		COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:nanolex> ${nl_file} -o ${GEN_DIR}
		DEPENDS nanolex ${nl_file} ${LEXER_SKELETONS}
		COMMENT "Generating ${lexer}Lexer.h with nanolex"
		)
	list (APPEND NL_HEADERS ${GEN_DIR}/${lexer}Lexer.h)
endforeach ()

add_executable(tests ${SRCS} ${HEADERS} ${GEN_HEADERS} ${NL_HEADERS})
target_include_directories(tests PRIVATE ${GEN_DIR})
target_link_libraries(tests NanoLexer nanolex_reader GTest::gtest_main)
add_test(NAME tests
		 COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tests>
		 WORKING_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR})

set(EXECUTABLE_OUTPUT_PATH bin/${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

add_custom_command(TARGET tests POST_BUILD
                   COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lexer_sk $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:tests>/lexer_sk)
